message: Type list<string is not defined. x-fern-type 'list<string' is not valid Fern type syntax: 'list<string' is neither a primitive, a container such as list<...> or map<..., ...>, nor a key of components.schemas, so Fern treats it as unknown.

Type Map<string, string> is not defined. x-fern-type 'Map<string, string>' is not valid Fern type syntax: 'Map<string, string>' is neither a primitive, a container such as list<...> or map<..., ...>, nor a key of components.schemas, so Fern treats it as unknown.

Type literal<1> is not defined. x-fern-type 'literal<1>' is not valid Fern type syntax: 'literal<1>' is neither a primitive, a container such as list<...> or map<..., ...>, nor a key of components.schemas, so Fern treats it as unknown.
x-fern-type 'map<string , integer>' uses 'string ' as a map key, but map keys must be primitive types; Fern ignores this type and falls back to the schema's own type.
